THE CUEPROMPT CREATOR GUIDE

Free Online Teleprompter with Camera Recording

Your script and camera. Together.

Record a product introduction, course lesson, or talking-head video without switching between your notes and a recording app. CuePrompt shows your script over a live camera preview while the browser records your camera and microphone.

Try the free teleprompter →

Set up your shot

Open the studio and choose Camera & record. Allow camera and microphone permissions, position your camera near the reading area, and check your lighting. Recording requires a compatible browser and a secure HTTPS connection.

Record, review, and try again

Press Record to begin a take and start the script. Stop & save downloads a video in the format supported by your browser, usually WebM or MP4. The recording contains your camera and microphone; script text is not burned into the video. Scripts and recordings are not uploaded.

Private by design

Your draft is saved on this device using browser storage. No account is required. Export a copy of important scripts before clearing your browser data. Camera recordings are created locally and downloaded when you stop a take.
